title: prodops_emit_event — Output
description: Canonical output contract for the prodops_emit_event tool. All players must produce a response that conforms to this schema.

status.description: 'accepted' = event processed and pipeline complete; 'skipped' = idempotent duplicate detected; 'dry-run' = validation + CE construction only, no side effects; 'error' = processing failed.

cloudevent.description: Full CloudEvent JSON produced by the tool. Populated only in dry-run mode or when --evidence-file is requested; null otherwise.

event-id.description: CloudEvent id (UUID) assigned by the runtime producer. Null on error.

event-type.description: CloudEvent type resolved from the catalog (e.g. 'prodops.delivery.bootstrap.started'). Null on error before catalog lookup.

correlation-id.description: Echo of the input correlation-id. Null if input parsing failed.

derived-state.description: Feature state computed from the full timeline after this event. Null on error.

github-sync.description: 'success' = GitHub Project fields updated; 'error' = sync failed (non-fatal, pipeline continued); 'skipped' = not attempted (idempotent or pre-error).

datadog-sync.description: 'success' = metric sent; 'error' = send failed (non-fatal, pipeline continued); 'skipped' = not attempted.

errors.description: List of error messages. Empty on success or skip.
